task.title: Actioning a fraudulent claim — Continuing claim that is blocked, archived or converted to MPS

step.cmd: Review the file (RCM, NIIS, SROC in NWS and Employer profile screen in RMDS) and determine if it contains fraudulent ROEs:
In RCM, determine if the fraudulent ROEs have been deleted:
Open each ROE identified as fraudulent by Integrity and delete them as follows:

ul.li:
Additional information: Enter the appropriate option:
If you are processing a Level 1 CR Integrity - ERB-EI Transition WI, type “Investigation completed. This fraudulent ROE must remain in deleted status (NIIS case [XXXXXX]).”
If you are processing a Level 1 AI WI, type “Suspicious ROE. ROE has been deleted until an investigation is completed. It can be restored if its legitimacy is confirmed.”

step.cmd: Determine if the following text appears in the Additional information section of the deleted ROE: “Investigation has been completed. This fraudulent ROE must remain in deleted status (NIIS case [XXXXXX]).”

ul.li:
If no and you are processing a Level 1 CR Integrity - ERB-EI Transition WI, do the following:
Additional information: Type “Investigation has been completed. This fraudulent ROE must remain in deleted status (NIIS case [XXXXXX]).”
Select Validate .
Select Submit .
Go to step 5.
If no and you are processing a Level 1 AI WI, go to step 5.

step.cmd: Determine if there are any fraudulent ROEs in the qualifying period (QP) of the client’s established claims:
Determine if any fraudulent ROEs were used to calculate one of the client’s established claims:
Determine if there is an outstanding CR Recalculation WI for the fraudulent ROE:
Determine if there is an outstanding CR Recalculation WI for the same BPC as the claim calculated with a fraudulent ROE:

ul.li: If no and you are processing a Level 1 CR Integrity - ERB-EI Transition WI, go to step 9.
If yes and you are processing a Level 1 CR Integrity - ERB-EI Transition WI, go to step 13.
If you are processing a Level 1 AI WI, go to step 25.

step.cmd: In SSO, verify that the correct mainframe is selected and assign a recalculation registration number as follows:

ul.li:
On the Claim Selection screen, do the following:
Social Insurance Number: Enter the client’s SIN.
Registration type: Select Recalculation .
Select Search .

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the claim to be recalculated is a commuter claim:
In SSO, modify the following fields on the Name and address screen as follows, if necessary:

ul.li: Ordinary place of residence different: Select Yes .
Residence postal code: Enter the workplace postal code.
Mailing address: Refer to Changing an address — Outside of Canada for more information on the required United States of America address format. Changing an address — Outside of Canada

Economic region - new and Economic region - old: In both fields, remove economic region code 99 . Enter the economic region code as follows:
If the economic region code used to calculate the initial claim is correct, enter this economic region code.
If the economic region code used to calculate the initial claim is incorrect, enter the economic region associated with the workplace postal code.
Responsible SCC: Enter the SCC associated with the workplace postal code.
On the Application Form screen, select Next .

step.cmd: On the Registration screen, do the following:

ul.li:
Pay SCC: Enter the SCC as shown in FTS. If the field is blank, enter the appropriate SCC:
Atlantic: Type “1121.”
Quebec: Type “2371.”
Ontario: Type “3515.”
Western Canada and Territories: Type “4812.”
Tentative BPC: This field is prefilled.

step.cmd: In NWS, determine the status of the outstanding CR Recalculation WI:

ul.li: If it is assigned to another officer, go to step 14.
If it is unassigned, go to step 15.
If it is assigned to you, go to step 16.

step.cmd: Determine in which workload the outstanding CR Recalculation WI is:

ul.li: If it is in the pending workload, go to step 15.
If it is in the current workload, contact and ask the officer to reassign it to you. Go to step 16.

step.cmd: In NWS, open the CR Recalculation WI and reassign it to yourself as follows:
In FTS, determine the BPC:

ul.li: If the BPC is w/c 2258 or after, go to step 17.
If the BPC is between w/c 2230 and w/c 2257 and it is a claim for special benefits other than sickness benefits, go to step 17.

If the BPC is between w/c 2230 and w/c 2257 and it is an EI ERB claim, the EI ERB claim must not be recalculated to change the rate or number of weeks of entitlement. Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and complete the registration number as follows:
Claim Allowed: Select NCA - No changes to the claim .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .
Go to step 25.

step.cmd: Refer to Recalculation and follow the appropriate task to recalculate the claim.
In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Message: Select 27 - An overpayment resulted due to an incorrect calculation .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the recalculation registration number.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 54 - Third party fraud .
Remarks line 1: Type “Fraudulent ROE — fraudulent third party.”

Remarks lines 2–4: Type “INS HRS [insurable hours], INS EARNINGS [insurable earnings], DIV WK [divisor], COD [cut-off date]. OP belongs to the client.” If necessary, enter the information regarding the claimant’s report and any other relevant information.
Remarks line 5: Type your name and telephone number.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the recalculation registration number.
Registration flag: Select 04 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: Determine if the recalculation has changed the BPC, hours or insurable earnings, resulting in an OP to the client due to a deleted fraudulent ROE:
Determine if, as a result of the recalculation, an established claim became BPNE due to a deleted fraudulent ROE:
In ACS, create and send the N-03-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Various Reasons - Claim was Recalculated (2683): Select Reviewed Calculation of claim .
Change to Family Supplement Rate - No longer entitled (2685)
Change in BPC or LRW – Reports need to be completed (2686)
Teachers: Benefit rate changed during non-teaching period (2689)
Insurability Ruling - Benefits are being suspended (2690): Select Blank .
Underpayment / Overpayment Message (2691): Select Overpayment Message .
Do not report monies already declared (2456)
Waiting Period Message(Amount of weeks of waiting period to serve) (2444)
Right to Request a Reconsideration (with Blank option) (4169)

This Letter Replaces or Footnote (2365): Do the following:
Select Footnote .
Text - Footnote (1066): Type: “Your claim was calculated using a record of employment that does not belong to you.”

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the B-01-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Opening Sentence - Refusal of benefits - Initial/Revised Claim - (one decision / multiple decisions) (2464)
Number of insurable employment hours accumulated (1366)
Start date of Regular qualifying period - Sunday’s date (1418)
End date of Regular qualifying period - Saturday’s date (1420)
Number of insurable employment hours required (1362)
Start date of Regular qualifying period - Sunday’s date (1418)
End date of Regular qualifying period - Saturday’s date (1420)
End date of Regular qualifying period - Saturday’s date (1420)

Overpayment Messages (2452): Select the appropriate option:
O/P on a Non-fraud active claim if the client has an active claim .
O/P on a Non-fraud inactive claim if the client does not have an active claim .

This letter Replaces or Footnote (2365): Do the following:
Select Footnote .
Text - Footnote (1066): Type: “We have reviewed the calculation of your claim. Your claim was initially calculated using a record of employment that does not belong to you.”

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there are cycling claimant’s reports completed by a third party:
Determine if there are cycling claimant’s reports completed by the client:
Determine if benefits are payable to the client for at least one of the cycling claimant’s reports:
Determine if the client is requesting benefits from the next expected claimant’s reports or after:
Determine if there is an outstanding registration number related to the same issue:
Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign a registration number as follows:
Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

Detection: Select the appropriate option:
If there is an Integrity registration number, this field is prefilled according to the type of investigation in NIIS.
If there is a revised registration number, select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Message: Select 27 - An overpayment resulted due to an incorrect calculation .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 54 - Third party fraud .
Remarks line 1: Type “Fraudulent claim — continuing claim — unknown third party.”

Remarks lines 2–4: Enter the appropriate option:
If the client is not entitled tosome or all of the weeks in the cycling claimant’s reports, type “Remove cycling claimant’s reports w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX].”
If payments must be issued to the client, type “Issue payments from w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX], CT [XX].”
If paycoding is required, type “[Appropriate paycoding, e.g. FWW, non-available days, sick days].”
If there is an allocation, type “M175 [type] [amount] from w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX], [amount, if different from last week].”
If a disentitlement must be imposed, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
If a disqualification must be imposed, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX].”
If an MA was imposed to stop payments, type “Rescind MA[XX].”
Remarks line 5: Type your name and telephone number.

step.cmd: In NWS, determine the type of WI:

ul.li: If it is a Level 1 AI WI, go to step 34.
If it is a Level 1 CR Integrity - ERB-EI Transition WI, go to step 35.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 04 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li:
Comments: Type the appropriate option:
“Client’s identity validated — fraudulent claim.”
“[Integrity file number] — fraudulent claim .”

Details: Type “The client’s identity, address and banking information were validated on [DD-MM-YYYY]. The client’s address is: [client’s address]. The client’s banking information is: [client’s banking information].” If you a processing a CR Integrity - ERB-EI Transition WI and Integrity identified fraudulent ROEs in NIIS, also type “Integrity has confirmed that ROE [serial number] is fraudulent.” Document the decision and rationale according to the Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: Create a ROD on the fraudulent application as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Fraudulent application — EI application submitted by a third party.”

Details: Enter the following information:
Relevant facts: Type “An EI application was submitted by a third party on [DD-MM-YYYY] using the client’s identity.”
Decision/Justification: Type “This EI application was not filed by the client and must not be included in an access to information request.”

step.cmd: Create a Reminder (REM) WI to delete the fraudulent application as follows :

ul.li: Due date: Enter the next business day.
Destination — SCC: Enter the SCC as shown in FTS.

End user: Do the following:
Select Specific user .
Enter the name of the team leader or the designated person.
Select Find user .

step.cmd: In NWS, determine the type of WI:

ul.li: If it is a Level 1 CR Integrity - ERB-EI Transition WI, go to step 39.
If it is a Level 1 AI WI, go to step 43.

step.cmd: In NIIS, on the Decision tab of the IC70 Report of Investigation screen , close the case as follows:

ul.li:
Disentitlement: Select No .
Reason: Select Other and type “The client’s information has been corrected.”
Overpayment: Do not check the box.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the Integrity registration number was completed:
Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and complete the registration number as follows:

ul.li: Claim Allowed: Select NCA - No changes to the claim .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the CR Integrity - ERB-EI Transition WI and all other related WIs.
Complete the AI WI.
